{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2017}}
{{main|2017 World Table Tennis Championships}}

[[Ding Ning]] successfully defended their title by defeating [[Zhu Yuling]] 11–4, 9–11, 4–11, 12–10, 11–6, 11–7 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ittf.com/2017/06/04/press-release-world-number-one-ding-ning-takes-third-world-championships-singles-title-ittf-worlds-championships/|title=Press Release: World Number One Ding Ning Takes Third World Championships Singles Title at ITTF Worlds Championships|date=4 June 2017|work=ittf.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2705&Singles=1 |title=Entry list |website= |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170510170159/http://www.old.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2705&Singles=1 |archive-date=2017-05-10 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 7 games in qualification and in the 128-player sized main draw.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |title=Playing system |access-date=2017-05-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170329113132/http://www.old.ittf.com/World_Events/2017WTTC/Playing_system_WTTC2017.pdf |archive-date=2017-03-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20170810105802/http://d3mjm6zw6cr45s.cloudfront.net/2016/11/2017_WTTC_WS.pdf Seeds]</ref>
